commitResults.messageBody:
New ZenException class to handle validation of inputs
Todo validation: validate description is not empty
Deadline validation: validate that there is only 1 /by present,
description and dueBy are not empty
Event validation: validate that there is only 1 /from and 1 /to,
description, start and end timings are not empty.
